_meta.study: ECON-014 Household Resilience Stress Test (HRST) - Phase 1
_meta.kinds: observed = sourced statistic; derived = computed from sourced statistics by a stated rule; policy = statutory design dial; scenario = scenario assumption; behavioral = literature-anchored behavioral assumption
_meta.closure_rule: DOCUMENTED SUBSTITUTION (lock section 6 rule): CE dollar LEVELS are per consumer unit (avg 1.7-2.4 persons) and do not transfer to specific household sizes; archetype budgets therefore apply CE lowest-quintile category SHARES (observed) to household monthly resources (income + transfers), with the category splits (rent/utilities/operations = 65/25/10 of the CE housing category) as derived assumptions. Baselines close by construction; the shock arithmetic on top is the study object.

sources.CE2024: BLS Consumer Expenditures 2024 (A01): lowest-quintile avg annual expenditures $35,046; housing share 41.6%; food $5,498/yr (15.7%)
sources.SCF2022: Fed SCF 2022: median transaction accounts, bottom income quintile $900 (top decile $111,600); median revolving balance conditional on carrying $2,700 (all families)
sources.SHED2024: Fed SHED 2024: 37% of adults could not cover a $400 emergency expense in cash or equivalent (sanity anchor only, not a model input)
sources.SSI2026: SSA 2026 COLA: SSI FBR $994/mo individual, $1,491 couple; resource limit $2,000/$3,000 (42 USC 1382, statute)
sources.SNAP_FY26: USDA FNS FY2026 COLA memo: max allotment family of four $994/mo (48 states + DC)
sources.UI: DOL/NELP/StLouisFed: UI replaces ~40% of prior wages nationally (state range ~43-67%)
sources.FPL2025: HHS 2025 poverty guidelines: $15,650 individual; $32,150 family of four; $64,300 at 200% (corpus-verified anchor)
sources.CH3: Ch 3 sec 7 + sourcing note 2026-07-26: A1 income $31,000; placement $2,800 at 5% = $140/yr (corpus-verified anchor)

dividend_rate.source: U-Shares design: 5% of original issue price, inflation-indexed

_meta.benefit_response_limitation: Transfers are held FIXED at baseline through shocks (except A4's UI rule). Real SNAP/EITC respond to income drops with lags; holding them fixed overstates stress in ALL arms equally and is flagged as a Phase-1 limitation. Dividend deltas (the study object) are approximately invariant to it.
_meta.dividend_benefit_treatment: Dividend and account principal excluded from SNAP/SSI means tests at baseline = the statutory-disregard DESIGN assumption (policy kind). Phase 2 T-H tests the OFF position.
